dimensions.name: Autonomous orchestration
dimensions.blocker: Core runtime, research, approvals, budgets and provider-connection controls are increasingly hardened, but website generation is still outside the canonical product, live payment is deliberately off, and no complete founder journey has run unattended across every required real provider.

dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: Revision :70 is healthy and export/malware scanning are now deployed, while main gained stronger state-machine, SBOM, OAuth and budget tests; however a verified backup restore, external 5xx/task-health alarms, edge throttling and whole-company deletion remain incomplete, and the newest main changes are ahead of the deployed revision.

dimensions.name: End-to-end customer fulfillment
dimensions.blocker: SelfOperate can authenticate, research, connect providers, export data and verify founder-controlled work, but Build My Website still has no canonical engine adapter and normal live checkout remains blocked until the Texas tax registration is active.

dimensions.name: AI workforce / agent capability
dimensions.blocker: Research is live-proven and bounded Gmail read capability plus stronger shared-budget controls are merged, but the broader AI workforce has not yet demonstrated a complete unattended production operation spanning all tools required to fulfill a customer.

dimensions.name: Premium website-generation capability
dimensions.blocker: The directly relevant Stromation engine remains capable, but SelfOperate still has no website-generation integration. The newer Phase 7I branch is unmerged and produced 0 of 2 eligible at-or-above-family runs, including one truth-gate refusal and persistent mobile weakness, so it is evidence of progress rather than current product capability.

dimensions.name: Commercial readiness
dimensions.blocker: The Stripe account and engineering cutover path are now verified ready, but live mode is intentionally parked until the Texas sales-and-use-tax registration applied for on September 19 becomes active. The newest privacy/terms, packaging and Gmail work also has not yet earned live deployment proof, and counsel review remains outstanding.

dimensions.name: Customer acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: SEO/GEO legibility is live and the offer architecture is clearer on main, but there is still no demonstrated repeatable lead-to-paid funnel, live payment is unavailable during the tax-permit wait, and the latest three-offer packaging has not yet been proven on the deployed site.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: There is still no verified paying SelfOperate/Business Builder customer cohort, recurring revenue, CAC, gross margin, retention or paid-delivery economics. Engineering and launch-readiness progress do not substitute for economic proof.

changed: The biggest change is that the payment blocker has narrowed from a partly unfinished commercial stack to one explicit external prerequisite: the live Stripe account was read-only verified with payouts enabled, details submitted and no outstanding items, every engineering cutover prerequisite is merged, and live mode is deliberately fail-closed while the Texas sales-and-use-tax registration applied for on September 19 is pending. SelfOperate also has customer export and GuardDuty malware scanning deployed, SEO/GEO legibility live on revision :70, and newer main-branch hardening for Gmail reads, atomic budgets, adversarial state transitions, container/web-image scanning, privacy/terms and a three-offer product model. There is no material merged regression, but most of that newest main work is not yet deployed, website generation remains unintegrated, and the unmerged Phase 7I website evidence is mixed rather than shippable.
method: Business Builder/SelfOperate-only independent forecast grounded in the 2026-09-20 canonical dariusstrongman/businessbuilder main, the live selfoperate.com revision :70 and rollback evidence, current Research Provider acceptance, deployed export and GuardDuty evidence, Stripe cutover/tax-registration truth, latest merged provider/security/commercial work, and only directly relevant Stromation website-engine evidence. Merged-but-not-deployed work is credited as implementation rather than live reliability proof; the unmerged Phase 7I branch is treated only as experimental evidence. Unrelated Stromation ventures, company-wide autonomy and Stromation customer/revenue status are excluded. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
